Specification: This module is a lightweight Apalache typing interface for another specification, AsynchInterface, rather than a standalone algorithm specification. It introduces typed declarations for one constant set and three variables, then instantiates the underlying AsynchInterface module so that the original spec can remain free of tool-specific annotations. The file itself contains no transition actions, temporal specification, or fault model; its main design choice is to provide a concrete enumerated value for the data constant used by external model configuration.
